responsibility: This header declares the reusable default implementations and shared constants for GCC's common target hooks. It exposes prototypes for the default exception-unwind selectors, default target option handler, valid-option-value enumerator, empty optimization table, and default multilib calculator so that common hook initializers and target code can reference these fallback helpers when constructing or overriding the gcc_targetm_common hook vector.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the paired implementation file, this header only publishes the interfaces to the shared default common-target-hook helpers and constants, so other common code and hook initializers can reference those fallback routines without defining them.
